items.title: Johnny DeDroit Interview, 1969-12-04
items.q: Now I didn't like him too much. And I know he didn't like me. I waited for my three bucks.

ctx.x: So a kid comes along with a hat full of balls.

And I said, hey Landry, this guy with a hat full of balls. I said, tell him to his face. I don't face you, it's not getting any of my golf balls, I'll tell you that. I went and he says, how much? He says, three dollars. He says, lend me three dollars. He said, no money. I loaned him three dollars. Now I didn't like him too much. And I know he didn't like me. I waited for my three bucks. So one day I go up in his office and he's got a couple in there. I always talk to him. I said, Mr. Landry, haven't you forgotten…
